title: Goldman Sachs Says AI Unlikely To Cause Widespread Job Losses In India, Services Sector Faces Risk
description: India is unlikely to see widespread job losses from artificial intelligence, Goldman Sachs said, citing the workforce’s concentration in physical and mechanical roles. Economist Santanu Sengupta said services jobs face greater substitution risks, particularly in IT and call centres, while gradual AI adoption could deliver productivity gains
content:
India is unlikely to experience widespread job losses due to artificial intelligence, although certain services-sector roles could face disruption, according to Goldman Sachs Chief India Economist Santanu Sengupta.
